lead_raw_text:
The structure of Y2Pb2 (Y4Pb4 per unit cell) crystallizes in orthorhombic symmetry with space group Pnma (No. 15). Its unit cell contains 8 atoms distributed over 3 independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows both Pb and Y centers adopt 12-neighbor close-packed-like local arrangements, with Pb surrounded by 8 Pb and 4 Y, and Y by 10 Pb and 2 Y. The geometric neighbor graph is fully 3-dimensional and connected across all 8 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner-, edge-, and face-sharing between Pb and Y 12-vertex coordination polyhedra, and corner- and face-sharing among like Pb or Y polyhedra.
